name: Hosts Identity Center Instance
description: An account's footprint in one region hosts an IAM Identity Center instance (footprint -> instance): an instance sso-admin:ListInstances returned whose PrimaryRegion is this region. A multi-region instance is returned by several regional endpoints and is emitted once, under its primary region's footprint; one whose primary region is outside the run's region scope is written with no footprint containment. Containment, parent -> child: the footprint declares this edge in CONTAINMENT_EDGES, so an instance the grid holds under a footprint whose account_region.identity_center_instances listing a run read to the end and did not name becomes a retirement candidate, which this type's falsifier then probes. Collected by the landing-zone reader (collectors/boto3_collector/landing_zone.py), which records that footprint's completeness surface under the same per-region rules as a manifest entry. One edge type per listed type: see tap_plugin.aws_core.regional.
